mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on future equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE falls below 4.0%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) above 1.3 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives corporate revenue growth and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1.3 million, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO falls below 100.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals broad-based demand strength, which increases corporate earnings visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST rise, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPIAUCSL above 317.5 with concurrent FEDFUNDS above 4.5% indicates persistent inflation and a restrictive monetary stance, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both CPIAUCSL > 317.5 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 159,500 and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.1% signals a labor market that is both expanding and tightening, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with strong hiring
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both PAYEMS > 159500 and UNRATE < 4.1%, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 23,400 billion with concurrent weakness in industrial production (INDPRO) below 101.0 signals a broad economic slowdown, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 < 23400 and INDPRO < 101.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
